item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera finds an unlabelled bottle of a colourless liquid in her kitchen. She knows that sour-tasting foods like lemon (citric acid) and curd (lactic acid) contain acids. Which is the correct and safe way to think about the unknown liquid?

options.A: Taste a drop of it; if it is sour, it must be an acid
options.B: It may be acidic, but unknown substances must never be tasted; test it safely with blue litmus paper instead
options.C: It is safe to drink because sour taste means it is a food acid
options.D: It is acidic only if it is yellow like lemon juice
